title: 第二十三章 这柄残剑曾镇过炉火第二十四章 徐少阳入局人炉钉入胸
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
偏殿后方的废器裂谷，比周荒想象中更深。
青丹殿曾经不只炼丹，也炼过丹炉、火钳、阵盘、药铲。炉毁之后，这些东西全被黑火烧残，堆在裂谷里，成了一座废器坟。
换成别人，看到满谷残器，只会绕路。
周荒却看得眼神发亮。
这地方若配上【变废为宝】，足够让一个杂役翻出半座宝库。
可惜现在不是那一周。
他只能看，不能碰。
这种克制比斗法更磨人。满谷残器都在诱他伸手，可现在的天赋是【趋吉避凶】，不是【变废为宝】。拿错一件，可能就是火毒入脉。
沈青禾瞥了他一眼。
“别什么破烂都想捡。”
周荒低咳一声。
“习惯了。”
顾清寒走在最前面，剑尖拨开焦黑废器。
“这里有新痕。黑炉的人比我们先来过。”
废器堆里有几处被翻动过，地上散着断裂的黑炉阵针。显然黑炉曾试图寻找什么东西，却失败了。
残破丹令在周荒掌心轻颤。
但这一次，它没有指向裂谷深处某件新法器。
令面忽然转向周荒腰间的储物袋。
周荒眼神一动。
储物袋里，那柄陪他打完外门小比、已经断成半截的乌鳞残剑，正低低震动。

这柄剑，是他当初在外门坊市花三十灵石买来的废剑。
小比决赛中，它替他挡过杀招，也在最后断成半截。
领奖之后，他有了青木离火剑，却没有丢掉这截残剑。
废物先留着。
万一下次刷到【变废为宝】，说不定能给自己一个惊喜。
现在，惊喜自己响了。
周荒取出乌鳞残剑。
半截剑身刚一露面，裂谷深处便有一点焦黑微光亮起。
不是新剑。
是一截焦黑剑柄，还有几片像鱼鳞一样的乌黑剑鳞，卡在废炉片下方。
残破丹令上的“守炉”二字同时亮起。
沈青禾低声道：“同源。”
顾清寒也看明白了。
“你手里的残剑，原本就是青丹殿守炉剑的一部分？”
周荒握紧剑柄，掌心微烫。
他当初三十灵石买来的废剑，并不是普通残剑，而是守炉弟子佩剑崩碎后流落出去的一截。
这一路被人当破烂卖，被他当底牌用，最后又被带回青丹殿。
残物归炉。
这比重新捡一把剑更让人背后发凉。
越往裂谷深处走，温度越高。

那不是寻常火热，而是一种压在经脉里的灼痛。每一件废器都像被黑火烧穿过，至今还残留火毒。
沈青禾撒出药粉，护住三人脚下。
content_en:
The abandoned weapon rift behind the side hall was deeper than Zhou Huang had imagined.
The Qingdan Hall once not only refined elixirs, but also made alchemy furnaces, fire tongs, formation disks, and medicine shovels. After the furnace was destroyed, all these things were burned by the black fire and piled in the rift valley, becoming a tomb of useless weapons.
If it were anyone else, they would only take a detour when they see a valley full of remnants of weapons.
Zhou Huang's eyes lit up.
If this place is equipped with [Turning Waste into Treasures], it will be enough for a handyman to dig out half of the treasure house.
Too bad it's not that week.
He could only look at it, not touch it.
This kind of restraint is more grueling than fighting. The valley full of remnants was tempting him to reach out, but his current talent was [seeking good fortune and avoiding misfortune], not [turning waste into treasure]. If you take the wrong one, it may cause fire poison to enter the meridians.
Shen Qinghe glanced at him.
"Don't want to pick up any junk."
Zhou Huang coughed.
"Get used to it."
Gu Qinghan walked in the front, the tip of his sword pushing away the charred waste weapon.
"There are new traces here. The people from Blackforge were here before us."
Several places in the scrap pile had been turned over, and broken black furnace needles were scattered on the ground. Apparently Blackforge had tried to find something and failed.
The Broken Pill Order trembled slightly in Zhou Huang's palm.
But this time, it didn't point to a new magical weapon deep in the rift.
His face suddenly turned to the storage bag on Zhou Huang's waist.
Zhou Huang's eyes moved.
In the storage bag, the black-scaled sword that had been broken into half after accompanying him to defeat the outer sect was vibrating lowly.
This sword was a useless sword that he bought in Waimenfang City for thirty spirit stones.
In the final of the small competition, it blocked his killer move and broke into half at the end.
After receiving the award, he had the Qingmu Lihuo Sword, but he did not throw away the broken sword.
Keep the waste first.
If you get [Turning Waste into Treasures] next time, you might be able to give yourself a surprise.
Now, the surprise rings of its own accord.
Zhou Huang took out the broken sword with black scales.
As soon as half of the sword appeared, a charred black light shone deep in the rift valley.
Not a new sword.
It was a burnt black sword hilt, and a few pitch black sword scales like fish scales, stuck under the scrap furnace piece.
The words "Shou Lu" on the broken pill order lighted up at the same time.
Shen Qinghe whispered: "Same origin."
Gu Qinghan also understood.
"The broken sword in your hand was originally part of the Qingdan Palace Furnace Sword?"
Zhou Huang tightened his grip on the sword hilt, his palms slightly hot.
The scrap sword he bought with thirty spirit stones was not an ordinary sword, but a piece of the furnace-guarding disciple's sword that fell apart after it shattered.
Along the way, he was sold as junk, used as a trump card by him, and finally brought back to Qingdan Palace.
The leftovers are returned to the furnace.
This is more chilling than picking up a new sword.
The deeper you go into the rift valley, the higher the temperature becomes.
It wasn't ordinary heat, but a burning pain pressing into the meridians. Every piece of useless equipment seemed to have been burned through by black fire, and the fire poison still remains.
Shen Qinghe spread the medicinal powder to protect the three people's feet.
